text:
Sasha: quick heads-up — dashboards have been stalling after canary deploy last night. Sparklines and heatmaps freeze for ~2-5s on initial paint, users seeing janky loads. Telemetry shows a big jump in KV cache misses and a 3x spike in prefetch requests. @Eli can you take a look?

Eli: seeing it now in APM. Console LCP + total blocking time are up. Waterfall spikes around /api/v1/prefetch/chart-data and we get a flood of duplicate requests. The new prefetcher from bundle v2.3.0 landed in canary.

Priya: I rolled the canary back to 2.2.8 on one host and the page improved immediately. This seems canary-only.

Tom: logs show a lot of 429s from our prefetch rate limiter and many repeated cache lookups for the same keys across simultaneous renders. KV latency also increased by ~30ms.

Sasha: possible regressions to consider: 1) aggressive prefetch policy, 2) telemetry sampler change that increased chart-level sampling, 3) a KV cache key normalization bug leading to misses and eviction thrash.

Eli: snippet from the network trace (simplified):

```
prefetch/chart-data?key=heatmap:tenant:123  200  12ms
prefetch/chart-data?key=heatmap:tenant:123  200  10ms
prefetch/chart-data?key=heatmap:tenant:123  429  5ms
prefetch/chart-data?key=heatmap:tenant:123  200  15ms
```

Priya: here is the prefetch config we shipped in 2.3.0: 

```json
{"prefetchEnabled": true, "maxConcurrentPrefetch": 12, "dedupeWindowMs": 0, "samplingMultiplier": 2}
```

Maya: confirming on telemetry: we bumped chart sampler to 100% for the canary to get more signals, that likely amplified the prefetch pressure.

Tom: short-term mitigation options: disable prefetch in the canary, cap maxConcurrentPrefetch to 4, or add client-side dedupe so multiple renders won’t trigger duplicate requests. Long term: server-side dedupe and per-tenant prefetch budgets.

Sasha: good plan. Action items: @Eli implement client dedupe + cap concurrent prefetch, @Priya rollback the aggressive sampling/prefetch flag from the canary, I’ll add an alert for KV miss rate and eviction count.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback started by Priya at 2409876600 — status: in progress.

Priya: rollback completed at 2409876675. Verified dashboards back to baseline on the canary host. Leaving a follow-up to instrument KV hit ratio broken out by tenant and route.

Eli: I’ll send a PR that adds a 200ms dedupe window and reduces maxConcurrentPrefetch to 4 for canary within the next 6 hours. Will also add a telemetry tag so we can correlate prefetch requests to sampler settings.

Sasha: closing loop for now. Created ticket REDW-4237 and added the rollback + dedupe plan. Postmortem + proposed fixes in #eng-platform-wg tomorrow. Thanks all :raised_hands:
